purpose: Make external sources and concrete place knowledge dominate visible quiz content, while canonical emner remain guidance and metadata.

hard_rules.production_path: external source or verifiable observation -> concrete claim -> question -> emne metadata
hard_rules.forbidden_production_path: emne -> place -> constructed question demonstrating the emne
hard_rules.source_dominance_rule: External historical/local sources must dominate the factual substance of the quiz. Canonical files may guide selection, progression, emne choice, theory choice and method choice, but may not be the main source of visible question content.
internal_file_only_questions_allowed_onl: explicitly logged fallback when no external coverage exists
question_seed_priority: canonical emner, fagkart, methods and theory as guidance only
forbidden_generation_patterns: Why does the place fit the emne
What makes the place relevant to the emne
How can the place be read as
What is the most precise academic reading
Which concept best describes the place when the answer only repeats an emne label
Which theory, theorist, method or hook fits best
Any visible reference to fagplan, fagkart, emnekart, mapping or topic hooks
hard_rules.answer_option_rule: Correct and incorrect options must be plausible, comparable in category and similar enough in length and register that wording alone does not reveal the answer.
hard_rules.template_repetition_rule: Do not mass-produce the same six-word question opening across places.

preferred_external_source_mix_per_place: at least one local history or encyclopedia source
at least one institution or official source
at least one complementary article, book, archive or museum source
soft_preferences.preferred_question_build_path: external source -> claim -> story or fact unit -> question
preferred_role_of_canonical_files: attach metadata after the question exists
choose useful concepts for knowledge text

validator_additions: Reject a quiz with fewer than 60 percent concrete facts when it has at least 10 questions.
Reject a quiz with more than 15 percent theory or concept questions when it has at least 10 questions.
Flag a quiz with fewer than 20 percent cause or context questions when it has at least 10 questions.
Reject visible questions built from forbidden emne, reading, theory or curriculum templates.
Flag repeated six-word openings used at least four times across two or more files.
Flag correct options that are much longer than both distractors.
Reject a question if it can be traced only to emne or hook names and not to a concrete external claim or observation.
Log per-question source_origin as external, mixed or internal_only when practical.
